# Calflow Task Outline & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar 14 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-14/`)
- **App slug**: `calflow`
- **Package**: `@free-react-templates/calflow`

## Structure & Sections

1. **Navbar**: Brand logo, search bar, quick notification bell, user profile avatar.
2. **Calendar Header**: Month/Year switcher, View mode selector (Month / Week / Day / List), "Add Event" CTA button.
3. **Calendar Main Grid**: Days of the week header (`Sun` - `Sat`), grid cells with date numbers, event badges, and selected state.
4. **Event Sidebar**: Selected date detail view, list of scheduled items with time/category badges, quick add event form.
5. **Footer**: Copyright, quick links, and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- Clean desktop calendar aesthetic matching Calendar 14's structured layout.
- Slate/blue accent palette.
- Fully responsive layout with mobile sidebar drawer support.
